tools.name: add_to_cart
tools.description: Add a product to the cart by its numeric product id (the id field returned by search_catalog). Works for simple products. For configurable products (type_id "configurable") the variant must be chosen on the product page — use open_page with the product url instead and tell the user to pick the options.

tools.name: get_cart
tools.description: Get the current shopping cart contents: line items with sku, name, qty, unit price, selected options and item_id, plus item count and subtotal. Works on any page.

tools.name: open_page
tools.description: Navigate the browser to a page of this store (a product url from search_catalog, a category, the cart page, etc.). Only same-origin store URLs are allowed. When this tool succeeds the browser is ALREADY navigating to the page — do not navigate again and do not tell the user to click links; just answer referencing the url.

url.description: Absolute store URL or path, e.g. "/checkout/cart".

tools.name: proceed_to_checkout
tools.description: Go to checkout. Verifies the cart is not empty, then navigates the browser to the checkout page. When this tool succeeds the browser is ALREADY navigating to checkout — do not navigate again and do not tell the user to click a checkout button.

tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Search the store catalog for products. Returns products with id, sku, name, url, image, price (incl. tax), price_excl_tax, original_price (when discounted), in_stock and type_id. Does NOT modify the cart; use add_to_cart for that. To show a product to the user, call open_page with the product url.

query.description: Search query, e.g. a product name or SKU.
